name: Asset Security
summary: Asset Security is the discipline of knowing what the organization owns, deciding how valuable and sensitive it is, and protecting information and resources through their complete lifecycle.
managerMindset: Protect the right thing at the right time: ownership, business value, sensitivity, lifecycle state, and regulatory obligations should drive proportionate controls.

crossDomainConnections.reason: D1 governance and risk establish ownership, valuation, legal constraints, and risk treatment for assets.
D3 architecture and cryptography implement protections for classified information and media.
D5 identity and authorization enforce who may access assets and for what purpose.
D6 testing and audit provide evidence that asset controls operate effectively.
D7 operations, backup, incident, recovery, and physical controls protect assets in use.
